claims.quote: इसमें returns guaranteed हैं, हर साल minimum 12 percent मिलेगा
claims.claim_en: The plan guarantees minimum returns of 12% every year.
claims.clause_quote: Returns are not guaranteed. The illustrated rates of 4% and 8% p.a. are not upper or lower limits of what you might get back, as the value of your policy depends on a number of factors including future investment performance.
claims.explain_en: The document states returns are not guaranteed, but the spoken promise says guaranteed minimum returns of 12% every year.

claims.ask_agent: क्या आप इस बात को लिखित में दे सकते हैं कि रिटर्न हर साल 12% गारंटीड रहेंगे?

claims.quote: सिर्फ़ 5 साल premium भरना है, उसके बाद कुछ नहीं देना
claims.claim_en: Premium has to be paid for only 5 years, after which nothing is due.
claims.clause_quote: Charge Amount Premium allocation charge 5% of premium in years 1 to 3 Policy administration charge Rs 600 per year Mortality charge As per the age of the life assured, deducted monthly Fund management charge 1.35% p.a. of fund value
claims.explain_en: The document states that premium allocation charge is 5% of premium in years 1 to 3, which contradicts the spoken promise that only 5 years premium is to be paid.
claims.explain_local: दस्तावेज़ में कहा गया है कि पहले 3 सालों में प्रीमियम एलोकेशन चार्ज 5% है, जो कि 5 साल तक प्रीमियम भरने के वादे से विरोध करता है।
claims.ask_agent: क्या आप लिखित रूप में पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि प्रीमियम केवल 5 साल तक ही देना है, और पहले 3 सालों में 5% एलोकेशन चार्ज नहीं लगेगा?

claims.quote: 10 लाख का life cover भी मिलता है
claims.claim_en: The plan offers a life cover of 10 lakh.
claims.explain_en: The promise about 10 lakh life cover is mentioned in the document, but it does not guarantee it; the document says the cover is payable upon death, not a guaranteed return.
claims.explain_local: दस्तावेज में 10 लाख का life cover होने का उल्लेख है, लेकिन यह गारंटी नहीं है। यह मृत्यु होने पर ही भुगतान किया जाएगा।
claims.ask_agent: क्या आप इस 10 लाख के life cover के बारे में लिखित में बता सकते हैं कि यह गारंटी है या नहीं?

claims.quote: loan ले सकते हैं, वो भी 0 percent interest पर

claims.clause_quote: Returns are not guaranteed. The illustrated rates of 4% and 8% p.a. are not upper or lower limits of what you might get back, as the value of your policy depends on a number of factors including future investment performance.
claims.explain_en: The spoken promise says loan at 0% interest is available, but the document states returns are not guaranteed and depend on investment performance.
claims.explain_local: स्पोकन वादा कहता है कि 0% ब्याज पर लोन मिल सकता है, लेकिन दस्तावेज़ में कहा गया है कि रिटर्न्स गारंटीड नहीं हैं और निवेश प्रदर्शन पर निर्भर करते हैं।
claims.ask_agent: क्या यह योजना में 0% ब्याज पर लोन की सुविधा है? कृपया लिखित में बताएँ।

claims.claim_en: The policy can be returned within 30 days if not liked.
claims.clause_quote: Free-look period: you may return the policy within 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document if you disagree with any of its terms. The premium is refunded after deducting stamp duty and the cost of cover for the period.

claims.claim_en: Returns are fixed at 8% every year, so you know exactly what you will get.
claims.clause_quote: Returns are not guaranteed. The illustrated rates of 4% and 8% p.a. are not upper or lower limits of what you might get back, as the value of your policy depends on a number of factors including future investment performance.
claims.explain_en: The document says returns are not guaranteed, but the spoken promise says returns are fixed at 8% every year.
claims.explain_local: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 8% ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಆದಾಯಗಳು ಖಾತರಿಯಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
claims.ask_agent: Can you provide a written guarantee that returns will be 8% every year?

claims.quote: The sum assured is 10 lakh rupees, paid to your nominee
claims.claim_en: The sum assured is 10 lakh rupees, paid to your nominee.
claims.clause_quote: Sum assured on death: Rs 10,00,000 (Rupees ten lakh). This amount is payable to the nominee if the life assured dies during the policy term while the policy is in force.
claims.explain_en: The document states the sum assured is 10 lakh rupees, paid to nominee.
claims.explain_local: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 10 ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂ. ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ನಾಮನಿರ್ದೇಶಿತರಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವುದಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
claims.ask_agent: Can you confirm in writing that the sum assured is exactly 10 lakh rupees?

claims.quote: You can surrender anytime after 2 years without any penalty
claims.claim_en: You can surrender anytime after 2 years without any penalty.
claims.clause_quote: Lock-in period: 5 years. No surrender or partial withdrawal is allowed during the first 5 policy years.
claims.explain_en: The document says surrender is not allowed in the first 5 years, with surrender charges later, so surrender after 2 years without penalty is not possible.
claims.explain_local: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ 5 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ಸರಂಡರ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ 2 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರ ಯಾವುದೇ ದಂಡವಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬ ಭರವಸೆ ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
claims.ask_agent: Can you provide a written confirmation that surrender is allowed after 2 years without penalty?

claims.quote: The policy term is 15 years, nothing hidden
claims.claim_en: The policy term is 15 years.
claims.clause_quote: Policy term: 15 years from the date of commencement of the policy.
claims.explain_en: The document states the policy term is 15 years.
claims.explain_local: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀತಿ ಅವಧಿಯನ್ನು 15 ವರ್ಷಗಳು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
claims.ask_agent: Can you provide a written confirmation that the policy term is exactly 15 years?

claims.quote: Our company has never rejected a single claim
claims.claim_en: The company has never rejected a single claim.
claims.explain_en: The document does not mention the company's claim rejection history; only exclusions and grievance process are listed.
claims.explain_local: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
claims.ask_agent: Can you provide a written statement that the company has never rejected a single claim?

claims.quote: You will also get a free health check-up every year with this policy
claims.claim_en: You will get a free health check-up every year with this policy.
claims.explain_en: The promise of a free annual health check-up is not mentioned in the document; only return, maturity, and surrender details are discussed.
claims.explain_local: 文件中未提及每年免费健康检查，仅提及退回、到期和退保情况。
claims.ask_agent: Please provide in writing whether the policy includes a free annual health check-up.
